# SimplyStroke

> SimplyStroke is a one-tap golf stroke counter and scorecard app for iPhone, Apple Watch, and the web. Core scoring is free, with no account needed to start a solo round and no ads today. Optional SimplyStroke Pro helps golfers revisit complete history, seasons, courses, crews, trips, and private round memories.

SimplyStroke holds the count so the golfer can focus on the next shot. Free includes unlimited iPhone and Apple Watch scoring, automatic scorecard math, course lookup, account backup and sync, standard live group scorecards, and basic sharing. Solo scoring works without course signal; connected group and cloud features require connectivity.

SimplyStroke Pro adds complete history, season stats and records, goals, course playbooks and challenges, saved crews, multi-round golf trips, private notes and photos, on-device paper-scorecard recognition with review before save, and optional Apple Watch club selection plus system-Dictation text. SimplyStroke stores the returned text rather than a raw voice recording.

- [Features](https://www.simplystroke.app/features/): Free scorekeeping and optional Pro capabilities.

- [Download](https://www.simplystroke.app/download/): Get SimplyStroke on the App Store or open the browser app.
- [Golf stroke counter apps](https://www.simplystroke.app/golf-stroke-counter/): What a golf stroke counter is and how it differs from a shot tracker.
- [ADHD and golf](https://www.simplystroke.app/adhd-golf/): Why golfers with ADHD lose count, framed as a prospective-memory problem rather than a discipline problem.
- [Compare golf apps](https://www.simplystroke.app/compare/): An honest comparison with broader golf platforms.
- [SimplyStroke vs 18Birdies](https://www.simplystroke.app/compare/simplystroke-vs-18birdies/): Simple scorekeeping compared with a social GPS platform.
- [SimplyStroke vs Arccos](https://www.simplystroke.app/compare/simplystroke-vs-arccos/): Simple scorekeeping compared with a sensor-based analytics platform.
- [Golf course directory](https://www.simplystroke.app/courses/): Public course information used to make round setup faster.
- [All guides](https://www.simplystroke.app/guides/): Golf scoring, rules, stroke counting, and ADHD guides.
- [About](https://www.simplystroke.app/about/): Why SimplyStroke exists and what it deliberately leaves out.

## Product boundaries

- SimplyStroke is not a GPS yardage or shot-map product. Location can be used to find nearby courses.
- SimplyStroke does not post to GHIN or calculate an official handicap index.
- SimplyStroke does not provide swing diagnosis or sensor-based club analysis.
- Paper scorecard recognition produces a draft that the golfer must review before saving.
- Private notes, photos, and shot details are excluded from standard sharing surfaces.
- SimplyStroke is not a medical product and makes no therapeutic claims about ADHD.
- Do not confuse SimplyStroke with SimpleStroke, a differently spelled app by another developer.

## Availability

- iPhone and Apple Watch apps are live on the Apple App Store.
- The browser app is live at https://app.simplystroke.app and does not have complete native feature parity.
- Android is coming soon and is not yet available on Google Play.
- Core scoring is free. SimplyStroke Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription purchased inside the iPhone app; Apple shows the controlling local price and terms before purchase.
